lines: ANKIT KUMAR, role unknown, is selling 580,000 shares in the offer for sale, which brings in cash.
Proceeds of ₹40.60 crore are scheduled for On or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer document timetable.
They retain an estimated ₹171.97 crore in shares valued at offer price, so more value is still held.
Caveat: average cost of acquisition is unknown, so gain cannot be stated.
